0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers, marking New York's first game of the year. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles ruptured), Dean Wade (out, ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (out, back) and Tacko Fall (out, hip).
